title: Async Trace Stitcher
user: An engineer debugging one failed customer transaction across their app, queues, webhooks, and vendors who needs a defensible timeline without deploying a full tracing platform.
smallest_useful_product: A local web app that accepts redacted JSON/NDJSON exports from logs and webhooks, correlates configured IDs and timestamps, displays a proposed timeline with confidence, and exports a shareable incident bundle.
success_measure: On five real incidents, an engineer produces a reviewable cross-system timeline in under 15 minutes and can identify every unmatched event explicitly.
constraints: Keep uploads in-browser by default; require visible correlation rules; scrub PII before export and never send vendor credentials.
